reviewKind: Static parser, resource-boundary and provenance review; no reader code executed

findings.finding: Malformed dictionary-shaped metadata can escape as AttributeError rather than the declared Fault refusal; asset=[] is a direct example. A JSON integer beyond the Python digit limit can raise ValueError outside the normalized exception list.
findings.recommendedAction: Enforce required object types or normalize parser/structure exceptions into Fault without claiming acceptance; add concrete refusal controls.

findings.finding: Bound file reads allocate the complete file before size or hash admission, and source-map hashing lacks a size precheck. The 4MiB parser ceiling therefore does not cap bound-file I/O allocation.
findings.recommendedAction: Use bounded reads plus source byte-length admission before hashing, and preserve exact hash binding.

findings.finding: Different accessor IDs can alias the same binary ranges yet allocate separately decoded value lists; input byte ceiling alone does not control expanded scalar count. Animation count<=4096 is checked after decoding the accessor count permitted up to100000.
findings.recommendedAction: Add an explicit cumulative decoded-component budget and role-specific pre-decode counts suitable for this finite family.

positiveFindings: Only Python standard-library imports and pure calculations/local reads are present; no product import, subprocess, native launch, model call or rebuild path appears.
Raw measurement explicitly labels artifact metadata untrusted; source association and historical byte qualification are distinct entry points.
Geometry and pose origins identify artifact digest, accessor/view offsets, sampled raw values and derived matrix operation.
Contract keeps ownership, physical/semantic parameters, revision acceptance, rebuild, atomicity, native routes and trial scores outside qualification.
Header/chunk sizes, table counts, accessor ranges/alignment, numeric finiteness, strict channel coverage and quaternion admission are checked.
unchangedHistoricalLimits: Not evaluated; this review does not qualify C255 numerical predicates, native routes, general glTF validity or model trials.

initialReviewedReader.retentionMethod: Reconstructed by reversing the one AttributeError exception-list insertion in captured subsequent source; exact SHA256 matches the source observed during initial static review.
